deals.name: HDFC Ltd–HDFC Bank
deals.key_synergy_lever: Funding substitution net of CRR/SLR reserve carry; limited corporate cost overlap
deals.evidence_quality: Medium for funding mix and reserve rules; low for modelled spread and substitution assumptions
deals.unquantified_items: Incremental PSL shortfall/PSLC cost; matched-tenor funding spreads; migrated deposit and liquidity schedules
deals.interpretation: Partial outside-in scenario only; not a reported synergy outcome.

deals.name: Air India–Vistara
deals.key_synergy_lever: Procurement scale, fleet/network optimisation, corporate overhead and systems rationalisation
deals.evidence_quality: High for pre-merger entity revenue, post-merger revenue/loss and integration milestones; low for attributable financial synergy
deals.unquantified_items: Category-level vendor spend/rate cards; procurement overlap; fleet utilisation and route contribution; one-off integration cost; service disruption costs
deals.interpretation: FY24 Air India and Vistara financials and FY25 merged results establish scale, but the transition-year figures do not isolate merger synergies.

deals.name: Zomato–Blinkit
deals.key_synergy_lever: Delivery-backend efficiency and customer cross-leverage between food delivery and quick commerce
deals.evidence_quality: High for consolidated operating cost disclosures and Blinkit segment trajectory; low for segment-level split and synergy attribution
deals.unquantified_items: Blinkit-only delivery and technology costs; matched-city cost per delivery; cross-order cohorts; incremental contribution after incentives; standalone counterfactual
deals.interpretation: FY24 cost pools are consolidated across food delivery and quick commerce and cannot be treated as standalone Blinkit addressable synergy pools.

deals.name: Microsoft–LinkedIn
deals.evidence_quality: High for LinkedIn segment revenue; low for causal cross-sell attribution
deals.unquantified_items: Matched customer attach, renewal and incremental contribution cohorts
deals.interpretation: Retained as an additional reference case, not one of the four core cases.

deals.name: Kraft Foods–H.J. Heinz
deals.key_synergy_lever: Procurement, SG&A, manufacturing footprint and distribution overlap
deals.evidence_quality: High for management target and reported cumulative savings; low for ex-post calibrated independent model
deals.unquantified_items: Pre-close category spend and headcount; audited recurring run-rate bridge; dis-synergies; full integration cash-flow reconciliation
deals.interpretation: Independent scenario is ex-post calibrated; cumulative realised savings are not directly comparable to annual run-rate target.
